summary: Chapter 13 of the be3_ai pipeline documentation. Covers the Schema Resolver and IDF Scoring system — the full Phase 1–6 scoring pipeline, ENTITY_TO_PARAM mapping, ACTION_TO_INTENTS mapping, schema fit calculation, IDF keyword scoring, all intent-specific signal rules (cart remove dominance, compare dominance, facet dominance, orphan noun rule, similarity dominance, discovery sentinel suppression), Signal Density Gating, and the final winner selection.
